description: This file defines the NotificationService class, which manages notification generation based on scheduled events, including periodic checks and morning notifications, within a Java Spring application.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for scheduling and generating notifications related to events, including cleanup of past events and notifications, and creating new notifications based on event timing.

methods.name: NotificationService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with repositories for events and notifications.

methods.name: checkIfGenerateNotification
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs every 5 minutes during working hours to check events and generate or delete notifications accordingly.

methods.name: generateMorningNotifications
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs at 8:30 AM on weekdays to generate initial notifications for the day's events.

methods.name: generateNotification
methods.description: Private method that creates and saves a new notification for a given event.
